capabilities: Read a folder's notes together via right-click context menu
Render notes in name order with numeric-aware sorting and title headers
Lazy-render large folders in batches of 15 while scrolling
Open the original note from a title or follow wikilinks, embeds, images, and tags
Refresh the view and restore it across restarts
extras: Only .md files directly in the folder are included; subfolders are not recursed and frontmatter is hidden. Also installable via BRAT (jagajaga/obsidian-folder-reader). README notes no network, no telemetry, and nothing written to the vault.
problem: Obsidian opens notes one at a time, so reading a whole folder of sequential notes (journals, chat logs, chapters) means clicking through each file.
summary: Renders all Markdown notes directly inside a selected folder as one continuous scrolling page, in name order, in a single tab.
